app.name: Tajer ID
app.slogan: One account. Both sides of the trade.

states.offline_body: Check your connection and try again.
states.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds}s.

auth.subtitle: Sign in to your Tajer ID workspace

register.title: Create your organization
register.mode_subtitle: This decides which workspace you get. You can add the other one later.
register.mode_trader_hint: I buy: browse suppliers, place orders, receive goods.
register.mode_supplier_hint: I sell: manage a catalog, ship orders, issue invoices.
register.mode_hybrid_hint: I buy and sell. You'll get a workspace switcher.
register.details_body: This creates your account and your organization together.

reset.forgot_body: We'll email you a 6-digit code. It's valid for one hour.
reset.code_body: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}.
reset.new_body: Choose a password you have not used on this account before.
reset.done_body: Sign in with your new password.

workspace.pending_review: This profile is still under review.

organization.no_organizations: This account isn't linked to an organization yet.
organization.details_subtitle: The legal identity a reviewer checks against your commercial registration.

onboarding.title: Finish setting up
onboarding.subtitle: Finish these steps, then send your organization for review.
onboarding.submit_hint: You can still edit anything until you send it.
onboarding.under_review_banner: Your organization is with the reviewer. You will be notified when it is decided.
onboarding.add_workspace_hint: Request a second profile and your organization becomes hybrid — you get a workspace switcher once it is approved.
onboarding.requested: Requested. The new profile appears once the backend accepts it.

home.coming_soon: This workspace's home lands in the next phase.
home.phase_note: KPI tiles, the attention feed and the quick-action grid arrive with the server-driven home in the next phase.
home.empty_body: Your figures and tasks will appear here as you start trading.

errors.sku_not_belong_to_draft_supplier: That SKU belongs to a different supplier.
errors.qty_less_than_min_order_qty: Below this SKU's minimum order quantity.
errors.qty_not_matching_order_step: The quantity must match the SKU's order step.

errors.pricing_not_found_for_sku: No price applies to this SKU for you yet.
errors.draft_has_no_lines: Add at least one line before submitting.
errors.draft_not_found_or_not_open: This draft is no longer open.
errors.relationship_is_blacklisted: This supplier has blacklisted your organization.

errors.relationship_must_be_approved_before_sub: The relationship must be approved first.
errors.reason_required: A reason is required for this action.
errors.credit_manage_permission_required_for_ov: This order failed the credit check. Ask a manager with credit permissions to release it.
errors.goods_receipt_edit_window_closed: The window for changing this receipt has closed.
errors.invoice_or_due_schedule_required: Pick an invoice or an instalment to pay against.
errors.cannot_follow_self: You cannot follow your own organization.
errors.product_not_accessible: You do not have access to this product.
errors.price_list_name_required: Give the price list a name in Arabic or English.
errors.scope_id_required_for_selected_scope: Pick what this price list applies to.
errors.max_qty_must_be_greater_than_or_equal_mi: The upper quantity must be at least the lower one.
errors.seals_can_only_be_set_before_dispatch: The shipment has already left; seals can no longer be changed.
errors.pickup_seals_required_before_dispatch: Apply the pickup seals before dispatching.
errors.supplier_or_trader_branch_missing: Both ends need a branch before a shipment can be created.
errors.credit_profile_can_only_be_managed_by_su: Only the supplier side can set credit terms.
errors.sku_not_belong_to_current_organization: That SKU belongs to another organization.
errors.post_invoice_return_transition_not_allow: Your side cannot make that decision on this return.
errors.invoice_issue_failed: The invoice could not be issued. Try again.
errors.purchase_order_not_found_for_supplier: That order is not one of yours.
errors.delivery_note_not_found_for_supplier: That shipment is not one of yours.
errors.price_list_not_found: That price list no longer exists.
errors.invalid_counterparty_organization: That organization cannot be a counterparty.
errors.no_active_request: There is no deletion request to cancel.
errors.already_subscribed: This organization has already used its trial.
errors.shelf_contract_not_found_or_not_accessib: You do not have access to that shelf contract.
errors.relationship_not_accessible: You do not have access to that relationship.
errors.no_shared_relationship_to_view_ratings: You can only see ratings for a relationship you are part of.
errors.approval_actor_not_allowed: You are not one of this document's approvers.
errors.request_already_exists: A deletion request is already open.

validation.expires_after_issued: The expiry date must be on or after the issue date.

profile.subtitle: Each profile is reviewed on its own. Holding both is what makes an organization hybrid.
profile.locked: This profile is being reviewed and cannot be edited.

branch.title: Branches
branch.subtitle: At least one branch is needed before you can trade — orders ship from and to these.

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.subtitle: Where settlements and payouts are sent.

document.title: Documents
document.subtitle: Upload the papers a reviewer needs — your commercial registration first.
document.type_code_hint: The code your backend team uses, e.g. vat_certificate.

supplier.title: Suppliers
supplier.catalog_hint: Browsable before a relationship is approved.
supplier.order_ready: You can order from this supplier
supplier.blocked_no_relationship: Request a relationship before you can order.
supplier.blocked_relationship_pending: Your relationship request is still under review.
supplier.blocked_relationship_not_approved: The relationship is not approved yet.
supplier.blocked_no_contract: An active contract is needed before ordering.
supplier.blocked_blacklisted: This supplier has blacklisted your organization.
supplier.blocked_not_ready: Ordering is not available from this supplier yet.

catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.rules_hint: These rules are the supplier's, and are what reject an order line.
catalog.no_skus: This product has no SKUs yet.

order.title: Order
order.snap_qty: Round up to a valid quantity
order.empty_hint: Orders appear here once you submit a draft.
order.cancel_requested: Your cancellation request is with the supplier.
order.cancel_reason_hint: Why should this order be cancelled?
order.note_required: A note is required for this action.
order.inbox_empty_hint: New orders from your traders land here.
order.cancel_requested_supplier: The trader has asked to cancel this order.
order.cancel_accept_body: The order will be cancelled. This cannot be undone.

shipment.title: Incoming shipments
shipment.seals_mismatch: The seals do not match the ones applied at pickup. Check the load before accepting it.

receipt.title: Goods receipt
receipt.hint: Count each line. Anything you do not account for is flagged against the driver's handover.
receipt.mismatch_warning: Your counts do not add up to what was shipped. You can still submit, and the difference will be flagged.
receipt.reason_required: Give a reason for every rejected quantity.
receipt.driver_mismatch: The totals do not match what the driver handed over. This receipt is flagged.
receipt.dispute_hint: Disputes are only possible while the edit window is open.
receipt.dispute_reason_hint: Describe what is wrong, in detail.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.claim_hint: Tell the supplier you have paid. They confirm it on their side.
invoice.issue_hint: Bill an order. Pick the shipment to invoice only part of it, or leave it empty to invoice the whole delivery note.
invoice.proforma_hint: Priced from the order alone, with no shipment.
invoice.pick_order_first: Pick an order to issue the invoice.

returns.title: Return goods
returns.hint: Pick the lines you are returning and say why. The supplier approves or rejects it.
returns.pick_a_line: Add a quantity to at least one line.
returns.submitted_hint: The supplier will approve or reject it.

supplier_catalog.title: My catalogue
supplier_catalog.rules_warning: These rules are what reject a trader order line: a quantity under the minimum, or off the order step, is refused before it reaches you.
supplier_catalog.min_hint: Below this, a trader order line is refused.
supplier_catalog.step_hint: Quantities must be a multiple of this.

pricing.title: Price lists
pricing.empty_hint: Without a matching price rule a trader cannot order a SKU at all.
pricing.scope_manual_id: This scope needs a target the app cannot look up yet. Ask your backend team for the id.

relationship.title: Trading relationships
relationship.suspend_confirm: Suspend this relationship? The trader will not be able to place new orders.

credit.title: Credit profile
credit.freeze_hint: These two switches are what stop the trader placing their next order.
credit.freeze_on_limit_hint: New orders are blocked once exposure reaches the limit.
credit.freeze_on_overdue_hint: New orders are blocked while an invoice is past its due date.

outbound.title: Outbound shipments
outbound.empty_hint: Delivery notes you create against an order appear here.
outbound.seals_hint: Apply the seals before dispatch — once it leaves, they can no longer be changed.
outbound.seals_locked: The shipment has left; seals can no longer be changed.

contract.title: Contracts
contract.empty_hint: An active contract is half of what lets a trader order.
contract.approve_permission: Approving a contract needs the contracts.approve permission.

shelf.title: Shelf
shelf.empty_hint: Consignment contracts you keep stock under appear here.
shelf.count_hint: The previous count is pulled from the last visit, so nobody has to remember it.
shelf.no_lines: Add the SKUs you are counting.
shelf.negative_sold: One of these rows implies a negative quantity sold. Check the numbers before submitting.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.topup_unavailable: No top-up method is available right now.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.billing_mode_hint: Pay a subscription, or let the platform take commission.
subscription.payment_note: Card payment runs through the payment gateway and is only available when the platform has it enabled.

rating.title: Ratings
rating.dimension_hint: The code your backend team uses, e.g. delivery_speed.

account.title: Account
account.nafath_hint: Confirm your identity through the Nafath app.
account.nafath_match: Open the Nafath app and pick this number.
account.delete_hint: Your organization data is removed after a grace period. You can cancel while the request is open.
account.delete_confirm: This starts the deletion of your account and its data.
account.deletion_pending: A deletion request is open on this account.
account.revoke_confirm: This device will no longer be able to sign in with biometrics.

shop.title: Marketplace
shop.subtitle: Buy and sell outside your trade agreements.
shop.no_favorites_hint: Tap the heart on a product to keep it here.
shop.no_address: Add a delivery address before checking out.
shop.checkout_split_notice: Your cart is split by seller, so this may create more than one order.
shop.checkout_partial: Checkout did not finish. Check your orders before trying again.
shop.no_chats_hint: Message a seller from a product or an order.
shop.remove_confirm: Remove this item from your cart?

trade.subtitle: Everything you trade, in one place.
